_header: Diego Venegas-Vargas | DAMIC-M collaboration | CCDarkSens Framework -- Example input: QEDark rate tables for the LBC heavy-mediator example scan (800 x 300 grid), standard halo of Baxter et al. (arXiv:2105.00599, Table 1).
_comment: Halo: v0 = 238 km/s, v_E = 253.7 km/s (the lab speed |v0 + v_sun + v_earth| of Baxter et al. on March 9, the value of the DAMIC-M 2025 analysis), v_esc = 544 km/s. Written to long_scan_vE253p7 so that the earlier v_E = 263 km/s tables in long_scan are not mixed with these. About 8 GB for 240,000 files.
